Application Data.NAME: Sunny Days Child Care Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Days Child Care Center provides a nurturing environment for children aged six weeks to five years. Our services include full-time and part-time care, educational activities, and meal provisions. We focus on fostering social, emotional, and cognitive development through structured play and age-appropriate learning experiences. Our facility is licensed and adheres to all state regulations, ensuring a safe and stimulating environment for children.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
Losses reported between 2018 and 2023 include the following:  
- On 03/15/2018, an incident occurred due to a slip and fall injury, resulting in a claim of $4,500. Status: Closed.  
- On 07/22/2019, a claim was filed for property damage caused by a storm, totaling $3,000. Status: Closed.  
- On 11/10/2020, a claim related to an allegation of negligent hiring was made, amounting to $5,000. Status: Open, currently under review.  
- On 09/15/2021, a claim was filed for a minor injury incident during an organized play activity, totaling $2,000. Status: Closed.  
- On 05/10/2022, a claim related to a facility-related incident caused by equipment malfunction was made, amounting to $2,225. Status: Closed.  
Total reported losses: $16,725.
